referenceDefinition.finiteEstimator: eligible center RGB weight 1 plus every accepted finite disk proposal RGB weight 1, divided by center plus accepted-proposal weight
referenceDefinition.limitingIntegral: conditional accepted-area RGB mean; the O(1) center sample is omitted, and an empty accepted set is undefined/null
referenceDefinition.physicalMapping: captured physical ellipse axes/orientation mapped with source/film dimensions, then capture radius cap; top-origin UV and GPU-observed gather-center ID/UV; nearest source texel; current validity, signed CoC, and view-distance acceptance rules

descriptions.golden-angle-count-dependent: Existing sqrt((i + 0.5) / N), (i + 0.5) * golden-angle disk sequence; count-dependent, baseline only.
descriptions.halton-2-3-progressive: Extensible Halton bases 2/3 mapped through sqrt(u) equal-area polar disk coordinates; exact prefixes across tiers.
descriptions.seeded-stratified-square-to-disk: Independently seeded jitter inside equal-area square strata, mapped to a disk with the concentric square-to-disk map.

samplingFamilies.coordinateFingerprintEncoding: FNV-1a 64-bit over proposal-order x/y IEEE-754 binary64 little-endian bytes; deterministic integrity checksum, not cryptographic hash
samplingFamilies.analyticQualificationScope: Each participating 1024-sample method/seed is qualified independently. Lower tiers retain structural proposal audits and tier convergence measurements; they do not inherit 1024 analytic qualification.

unitDiskSecondMoment.rationale: At N=1024 the fixed tolerance allows finite deterministic/randomized variation while rejecting the measured center-biased 0.125 and uniform-radius 0.333 signatures.

uniformColor.detail: uniform valid Far color is invariant under aperture integration

affineGradient.detail: symmetric continuous-disk average equals center color; raster field is symmetric around center texel

planarBoundary.detail: symmetric half-plane integral with explicit half-coverage center source texel

radiusCap.detail: physical ellipse is mapped to source pixels before the 5 px radius cap is applied

unitDiskAreaMoment.detail: equal-area unit-disk proposals satisfy E[x^2 + y^2] = 1/2; a fixed 0.03 finite-sample tolerance rejects center and uniform-radius bias

sharpSourceNegativeControl.detail: sharp-source substitution is rejected because it removes the analytic defocus transition

limitations: CPU finite and limiting estimates remain numerical approximations; only synthetic analytic controls have exact expected outcomes.
A small sparse ROI can qualify only its exact optical state and selected pixels, not a scene-wide reference.
The native run does not establish browser/device-wide behavior or photographic ground truth.
GPU/CPU Full32 and Full64 comparisons are diagnostic and do not independently establish the limiting aperture integral.
The existing CPU128/CPU256 divergence remains historical and CPU256 remains unqualified as ground truth.
recommendedNextPr: If any critical stratum remains unresolved, investigate a separately implemented adaptive/quadrature reference and spatial edge-spread measurements without changing the M5 gather.
